title: Book Two · Chapter 143: The Back of the Card
story:
For the spring practice, Miss Wu brings a box of short cards. Each card gives a visitor a small problem. Ronan picks one with a blue mark.

A pupil needs two picture sheets for Friday. The materials room has one copy of each. On the back, a note gives the return rule. Pupils may keep the sheets for only one day.

Ronan reads the front and prepares an answer. Then he turns the card over.

“Oh,” he says.

Jun is across the table. Today they are in a group of four for practice. Miss Wu has put them in this group. Jun has not chosen to be Ronan's partner again.

“What?” Jun asks.

“The return day matters.”

Ronan reads the back aloud. The group puts the borrowing day and return day on two separate slips.

Another pupil asks, “Can the visitor take them on Thursday?”

“Yes,” Ronan says. “Return them on Friday.”

“But he needs them on Friday.”

Ronan looks again. The room is open after lunch. The visitor needs the sheets in the morning.

“Then he needs to ask about a different return time,” Ronan says. “The card does not give that.”

Jun nods. “We cannot make up permission.”

They write the question for the teacher in charge. Miss Wu comes to see their work.

“Whose answer is this?”

“We made it together,” Ronan says.

“Which parts?”

Ronan gives his first answer. Then he explains how the other pupil and Jun helped him change it. Miss Wu writes GROUP WORK at the top.

She gives them a new small card to try alone. This one has enough information for an answer. Ronan reads both sides before he writes.

At the end, Jun asks to borrow the ruler on the table. Ronan passes it to him.

“Was that all right?” Ronan asks.

“The ruler?”

“The group.”

“Yes.”

“Would you—”

Jun looks up.

Ronan stops and smiles a little at himself.

“I know. This group was the teacher's arrangement.”

Jun smiles too, but only briefly.

“Your answer about asking was useful.”

“Your permission point was useful.”

They put the separate slips back into the box. Miss Wu puts their group answer in one tray. Ronan puts his own card in another. He answered that card alone.

On the way home, he buys bread from the agreed money. The seller asks if he wants two extra small rolls. He checks the coins before he says yes or no.

“No extra today,” he says.

The seller gives him the usual packet. At home, three rolls fit on the plate exactly. Dad reaches for one before Mum sits down, and she catches his wrist with a laugh.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

permission＝允许；independent＝独立的；visitor＝来访者；return day＝归还日。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么不能自作主张延长借期？
2. 老师怎样标明共同完成与独立完成？

## 读句子

**Ronan / reads both sides / before he writes.** Ronan／先读两面／再写。
